test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements CORRECTLY defines Southern Oscillations?

options.text: Periodic changes in the pressure conditions in the Pacific Ocean and Indian Ocean.
The reversal of jet streams during the monsoon season in India.
The periodic reversal of winds in the Indian peninsula.
The periodic changes in the pressure conditions of various parts of India due to shift in ITCZ.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Periodic changes in the pressure conditions in the Pacific Ocean and Indian Ocean.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Southern Oscillation** refers to the periodic fluctuations in air pressure between the tropical eastern Pacific Ocean and the tropical western Indian Ocean.
 
• It is closely associated with the El Niño-Southern Oscillation (ENSO) phenomenon, where changes in pressure affect global weather patterns.
 
• During the Southern Oscillation, there is a shift in pressure systems, which impacts wind patterns and ocean currents, significantly influencing climate variability.
 
• This phenomenon is measured using the **Southern Oscillation Index (SOI)**, which compares the pressure differences between Tahiti (Pacific Ocean) and Darwin (Indian Ocean).
